adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `refreshOAuthTokens` which, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`, calls `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` and returns that fetch `Response` object (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts). In Zoho CRM’s refresh flow, the code now wraps an axios request with `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` but still treats the returned value as an axios response: `const zohoCrmTokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...); if (!zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error) { ... }` (packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts). In sync mode, `zohoCrmTokenInfo` would be a fetch `Response` without a `.data` property, so `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data` is `undefined` and accessing `.error` will throw a TypeError, breaking token refresh in credential-sharing deployments.
